title: Interview scheduling software features
description: Self-scheduling links, no-show defense, candidate status pages, calendar sync, ATS integration, and privacy-first data handling in one recruiting tool.

faq.a: The recruiter sends one private link; the candidate picks from slots where every required interviewer is genuinely free, shown in the candidate's own time zone. The slot is reserved atomically and calendar events are created automatically.

faq.q: What happens when a candidate does not confirm an interview?
faq.a: Cadence runs a confirmation cascade: a reminder with one-tap confirmation, then a recruiter alert if the candidate stays silent, so the team can rebook or release the slot before the interview is wasted.
Yes. After each interview, interviewers get a private scorecard link with a submission deadline and reminders; recruiters see submitted scorecards on the candidate record.
